name: agentpay
description: AgentPay — Main UI Frontend + Bryan Backend Integration

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentpay/core && npm run build -w @agentpay/server && npm run build -w @agentpay/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @agentpay/server" "npm run dev -w @agentpay/frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,frontend "npm run start -w @agentpay/server" "npm run start -w @agentpay/frontend"
